result.instructions: Tools for Harvest, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Harvest data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run harvest_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run harvest_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run harvest_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. harvest_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: harvest_list_time_entries
tools.title: List time entries
tools.description: List time entries, optionally filtered by user, project, client, task, date range, running/billed status, or updated-since. Paginated. Harvest REST: GET /time_entries.

user_id.description: Filter to a single user id.

client_id.description: Filter to a single client id.

project_id.description: Filter to a single project id.

task_id.description: Filter to a single task id.

is_running.description: Only running (true) or only stopped (false) entries.

from.description: Only entries on/after this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

to.description: Only entries on/before this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

updated_since.description: Only entries updated since this ISO-8601 datetime.

tools.name: harvest_create_time_entry
tools.title: Create time entry
tools.description: Create a time entry. Requires project_id, task_id and spent_date. Provide `hours` to log a specific duration; OR provide `started_time` (+ optional `ended_time`) for a timestamped entry; OR omit both to start a running timer (on a timestamp-tracking account). Use harvest_list_project_assignments to find valid project_id + task_id. Harvest REST: POST /time_entries. WRITE — creates data.

project_id.description: The project id to log time against (required).

task_id.description: The task id within the project (required).

spent_date.description: The date the time was spent, yyyy-mm-dd (required).

user_id.description: Log on behalf of another user (defaults to the authenticated user; requires permission).

hours.description: Duration in decimal hours, e.g. 1.5. Omit to start a running timer.

started_time.description: Start time for a timestamped entry, e.g. '8:00am'.

ended_time.description: End time for a timestamped entry, e.g. '9:30am'.

tools.name: harvest_update_time_entry
tools.title: Update time entry
tools.description: Update an existing time entry's hours, notes, spent date, or project/task. Only the fields you provide are changed. Harvest REST: PATCH /time_entries/{id}. WRITE — modifies data.

time_entry_id.description: The time entry id to update (required).

project_id.description: Reassign to a different project id.

task_id.description: Reassign to a different task id.

hours.description: Change the duration in decimal hours, e.g. 2.25.

tools.name: harvest_stop_time_entry
tools.title: Stop running time entry
tools.description: Stop a currently running time entry (no-op error if it is already stopped). Harvest REST: PATCH /time_entries/{id}/stop. WRITE — modifies data.

time_entry_id.description: The running time entry id to stop (required).

tools.name: harvest_restart_time_entry
tools.title: Restart stopped time entry
tools.description: Restart a previously stopped time entry, resuming its timer (error if it is already running). Harvest REST: PATCH /time_entries/{id}/restart. WRITE — modifies data.

time_entry_id.description: The stopped time entry id to restart (required).

tools.name: harvest_delete_time_entry
tools.title: Delete time entry
tools.description: Permanently delete a time entry by id. This cannot be undone. Harvest REST: DELETE /time_entries/{id}. WRITE — destroys data.

time_entry_id.description: The time entry id to delete (required).
